purpose: Teach: ルノー/葛飾/ジャッキー/ポーカー/ドラクエ/マスターズ/ワンセグ/スペースシャトル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ルノーの車に乗ってお越しになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customer came by in a Renault.
lines.style: Warm, almost admiring observation. Gentle rise on the detail. Sharing something she noticed about someone. Soft, conversational — not gossip, just noticing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、葛飾の柴又にお住まいだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customer lives in Katsushika, in Shibamata.
lines.style: Following along, adding her own piece. Same warm noticing. A beat of interest — Shibamata is specific, worth the fact. Quiet pleasure in the detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジャッキーチェンの映画ファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customer's a Jackie Chan fan.
lines.style: Slightly delighted by this one. Lighter attack. A small smile in the voice — this detail is charming. Still observant, but warmer about it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ポーカーのトーナメントに出られるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customer plays in poker tournaments.
lines.style: Impressed, steady. Eyebrows up slightly in the voice. Respectful acknowledgment of the detail — something interesting, something with commitment behind it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ドラクエの新作待ちだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customer's waiting for the new Dragon Quest game.
lines.style: Genuine warmth on this. A knowing quality — she gets the wait, the anticipation. Not mocking. Tender recognition of a shared human thing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゴルフのマスターズ観戦されてたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customer was watching the Masters golf tournament.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly surprised. The detail lands — this is someone with depth, interests, a life beyond the counter. Respectful admiration in the pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ワンセグでテレビを見ながら勉強してたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customer was studying while watching One-seg TV.
lines.style: A beat of recognition here. Quiet affection for the effort, the hustle. Not condescending — just noticing someone who was working. Understands the grind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スペースシャトル時代のNASA勤務だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customer used to work for NASA back in the Space Shuttle days.
lines.style: Final detail, quiet awe. The voice settles into respect. This is someone who *lived* through something. Slower pace. Closing observation with reverence.
